mapper.select: SELECT mtw.*, su.name AS reporter_name, mbtul.user_id AS team_leader_id, mbtul.user_name AS team_leader_name, mtwqc.name AS temp_work_quota_config_name, CONCAT(cp.serial_number, ' ', cp.short_name) AS project_name FROM mes_temp_work mtw LEFT JOIN mes_temp_work_quota_config mtwqc ON mtwqc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mtw.temp_work_quota_config_id = mtwqc.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mtw.reporter_id = su.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link mbtul ON mbtul.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbtul.team_id = mtw.team_id AND mbtul.bool_leader_enum = 1 LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mtw.project_id = cp.id WHERE mtw.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mtw.id = #{id}

SELECT mtw.report_date, mtw.create_time, reporter.id AS 'reporter.id', reporter.name AS 'reporter.name', team.id AS 'team.id', team.name AS 'team.name', mtwqc.id AS 'tempWorkQuotaConfig.id', mtwqc.name AS 'tempWorkQuotaConfig.name', mtw.reason, project.id AS 'project.id', project.name AS 'project.name', project.short_name AS 'project.shortName', project.serial_number AS 'project.serialNumber', mtw.work_milliseconds, mtw.description, mtw.price, ROUND(mtw.amount, 2) AS amount, ROUND(mtw.calculate_amount, 2) AS calculate_amount, mtw.approval_status, mtw.approve_record_id, mtw.approval_time FROM mes_temp_work mtw LEFT JOIN sys_user reporter ON reporter.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND reporter.id = mtw.reporter_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbt.*, mbtul.user_name AS name FROM mes_building_team mbt LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link mbtul ON mbtul.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbtul.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND mbtul.team_id = mbt.id WHERE mbt.bool_delete_enum = 0 ) team ON team.id = mtw.team_id LEFT JOIN mes_temp_work_quota_config mtwqc ON mtwqc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mtwqc.id = mtw.temp_work_quota_config_id LEFT JOIN contract_project project ON project.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND project.id = mtw.project_id WHERE mtw.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE(mtw.create_time) >= #{createStartDate} AND DATE(mtw.create_time) <= #{createEndDate} AND DATE(mtw.report_date) >= #{reportStartDate} AND DATE(mtw.report_date) <= #{reportEndDate} AND team.workshop_id = #{workshopId} AND mtw.temp_work_quota_config_id = #{tempWorkQuotaConfigId} AND mtw.project_id = #{projectId} AND mtw.approval_status = #{approvalStatus} AND team.name LIKE concat('%', #{teamName}, '%') AND reporter.name LIKE concat('%', #{reporterName}, '%')
